# JBIG2 interoperability fixtures

The 29 valid files contain 99 pages with independent pixel hashes.
The UBC streams come from `test/resources` in insinfo/jbig2 revision
`d76c359e66c92781e8c258f3d633ee50fc8b94c5`. The remaining documents were downloaded
directly from Apache PDFBox JBIG2 ImageIO's `src/test/resources` at revision
`946a08e8b3b9a74f95f3d80dad98b783d13ea069`:
<https://github.com/apache/pdfbox-jbig2/tree/946a08e8b3b9a74f95f3d80dad98b783d13ea069/src/test/resources>.

The manifest records both origins. The Apache corpus includes 17-page and
15-page scanned documents, shared symbol dictionaries and negative refinement
offsets. `001.jb2` is actually compressed Flash (`CWS`); it is deliberately kept
as a rejection test and listed in `oracle_failures.json`, outside the 29 valid
files. It produces no page with jbig2dec.

- `042_*.jb2` and `amb_*.jb2`: UBC SPMG streams redistributed by the upstream
  project under Apache-2.0.
- `002.jb2`, `003.jb2`, `005.jb2`, `006.jb2` and `201231100*.jb2`: scanned
  documents from the Apache test corpus, under its Apache-2.0 license.
- `21.jb2`, `21.glob`: the upstream issue 21 PDF image and global dictionary.

See `third_party/jbig2/LICENSE` and `third_party/jbig2/NOTICE` for the upstream
terms and attribution. No ITU non-commercial Annex H sample data is included.

`manifest.json` records each input's original relative path, SHA-256, dimensions,
and SHA-256 of tightly packed opaque RGBA pixels decoded independently using
the system `libjbig2dec.so.0` (jbig2dec 0.20 API). The expected pixel hashes were
not generated by Imcodec. Black becomes `(0, 0, 0, 255)`, white becomes
`(255, 255, 255, 255)`; padding bits are excluded. `21.glob` is passed as an
embedded global stream before its page. Tests verify the source hashes and
compare decoded pixels against these fixed independent hashes.

The corpus covers arithmetic and Huffman coding, dictionaries, refinements,
halftones and MMR across the selected UBC streams. Tests also construct
random-access and multi-page containers, truncated payloads and invalid
references. All test fixtures are excluded from the published package.
